test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Vengeance"** refers to the act of inflicting punishment or harm in return for a wrong or injury. (प्रतिशोध)

 
 
• **Example:** He sought vengeance against the person who betrayed him.
 
 
 
• The passage talks about forgiving an injury versus giving in to resentment; here, the word in blank 3 should indicate a retaliatory act.
 
• Other options like **jurisprudence** (कानूनशास्त्र), **overabundance** (अत्यधिकता), and **noncompliance** (अपालन) do not convey the meaning of retaliation or revenge.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jurisprudence** (कानूनशास्त्र): The study or theory of law.

 
 
• **Example:** He enrolled in a course on jurisprudence to better understand legal principles.
 
 
 
• **Overabundance** (अत्यधिकता): An excessive quantity or surplus.
 
 
• **Example:** The garden had an overabundance of flowers this spring.
 
 
 
• **Noncompliance** (अपालन): Failure or refusal to follow rules or instructions.
 
 
• **Example:** Noncompliance with safety regulations can result in fines.
 
 

139:Tc97,
The correct answer is **Option 1**.</s
